inventory.notes: Inspected alone at 900px. One donkey with red glasses, tan bridle and chest harness; one easel; junction box with pink/teal/violet cables to three racks; teal lead on harness ring. Added only a flat gray two-button controller with cord, and on the canvas a navy night sky, six white pixel stars, a pale pixel moon, a pink pixel diamond with lighter inner diamond, a teal ground strip. No bricks, hills, clouds, characters, faces or text.

orientation.notes: Donkey in profile facing right as in the base; the pixel scene follows the canvas three-quarter perspective inside its edges; controller face toward the viewer, d-pad left, red buttons right.

contact.notes: Three hooves on the ground shadow; raised hoof supports the controller from below; its cord hangs to the floor and ends in a loop; easel legs grounded; cables enter box and rack ports as in the base.
